build_FullyConnectedActor: build a FullyConnectedActor model mapping state to action with configurable hidden layer sizes and activations
build_GaussianFullyConnectedActor: build a GaussianFullyConnectedActor that samples actions from a multi-dimensional Gaussian distribution with tanh squashing
build_DirichletFullyConnectedActor: build a DirichletFullyConnectedActor that samples actions from a Dirichlet distribution for actions summing to one
build_StochasticActor: build a StochasticActor composed of a scorer and sampler to score and sample actions
review_GaussianFullyConnectedActor_get_l: review the GaussianFullyConnectedActor get_log_prob method that computes log probability with tanh squash correction
